fact: The OPPO mobile phone factory in Tenth of Ramadan City, built on a USD 50 million investment, was opened by the Prime Minister with 17 production lines and capacity of about 5 million smartphones a year, and Egypt hosts 15 international mobile brands producing up to 20 million units a year.
title: From MoU to Mega-Factory: ITIDA Celebrates Opening of $50M OPPO Smartphone Plant in Egypt
